articles.title: Delta Air Lines Earnings Beat Expectations. Why the Stock Is Dropping.
articles.mainIdea: Delta Air Lines Earnings Beat Expectations. Why the Stock Is Dropping.
articles.summary: Barrons.com: Delta Air Lines Earnings Beat Expectations. Why the Stock Is Dropping.. Delta Air Lines stock was falling early Tuesday after the airline beat earnings expectations but issued disappointing guidance for the year ahead. Delta reported adjusted earnings per share of $1.55 on revenue of $14.6 billion in the fourth quarter. Investors may be focusing on Delta’s full-year guidance for 2026, which came in lower than Wall Street’s view. Related tickers mentioned: AAL, AXP, DAL, FDS, LUV.
